Hi, I'm Jessica — a Business student majoring in Marketing!

Third-year Marketing student specialising in Brand Management. Moved to Europe alone at 18 — independent, adaptable, and globally minded.

Managed the company's Meta Business Suite and LinkedIn during my last internship, building its earliest social presence through content calendars, content creation, copywriting, and short-form video.

Curious, eager to learn, try-fail-learn minded, and still passionate about the field I study. I'm seeking a mandatory internship to fulfil my degree requirement.

LEVEL 1-5
CHEP Return Match
School assignment · Logistics & sustainability
Brief: optimise CHEP and make it more sustainable
An app concept so no truck drives home empty: after a delivery, it finds empty CHEP pallets waiting along the way back, so the return trip collects them instead of a second truck making the journey.
What I delivered:
  • Return-trip matching that shows empty km and CO₂ saved
  • A demand signal that flags pallet surges before they hit
  • A clickable phone prototype with demo shipments
